normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- Private pool and sitting spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $30 per day. The pool and spa are heated together.- Fire pit- 6 adult bikes provided- 6- passenger electric Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Sunshine Smiles is a gorgeous 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom Main House and Carriage House that sleeps 12 in the peaceful Lake District community of WaterColor. With over 3,400 square feet of living space, guests will love the private pool, sitting spa, firepit area, and second-floor balcony with stunning views. Less than a mile from the nearest beach access and next door to the community Dragonfly pool, this coastal property will make everyone smile!This newer 2-story home welcomes guests into the Main House's great room with hardwood floors, shiplap walls, and luxurious coastal furnishings. Plush seating surrounds the 75" TV in the living area, as natural lighting streams in from the large picture windows. Elegant French doors open to a private backyard oasis with a covered deck and alfresco dining table, firepit area, and a private pool with an attached sitting spa—perfect for entertaining! The gourmet kitchen inside is every chef's dream, with high-end appliances, stunning marble countertops, and an extra-large kitchen island with a farmhouse sink. A quaint dining area offers a mix of chair and bench seating for 8, while the breakfast bar seats 9. There is 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed down the hallway.Guests can relax and unwind in the spacious second-floor bedrooms after a long day at the beach. There is 1 primary bedroom with a king bed and access to a private balcony, 2 guest bedrooms with a king and queen bed, and 1 bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds—great for kids and young adults.Above the garage is a charming Carriage House that offers guests a cozy yet private space to decompress at the end of the day. Boasting a quaint kitchenette, comfortable living area, and stacked washer and dryer, guests can enjoy all the conveniences of the big house. There's also 1 guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.Sunshine Smiles is the perfect home base for large groups or families. With WaterColor's courtesy trolley and on-site parking for 5 vehicles it's easy to explore the local area. Book Sunshine Smiles today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: Queen, Shared Bathroom With Shower OnlyBunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom With Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. The pool and spa are heated together. - Fire pit - 6 adult bikes provided - 6- passenger electric Low-Speed Vehicle - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Sunshine Smiles is a gorgeous 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom Main House and Carriage House that sleeps 12 in the peaceful Lake District community of WaterColor. With over 3,400 square feet of living space, guests will love the private pool, sitting spa, firepit area, and second-floor balcony with stunning views. Less than a mile from the nearest beach access and next door to the community Dragonfly pool, this coastal property will make everyone smile! This newer 2-story home welcomes guests into the Main House's great room with hardwood floors, shiplap walls, and luxurious coastal furnishings. Plush seating surrounds the 75" TV in the living area, as natural lighting streams in from the large picture windows. Elegant French doors open to a private backyard oasis with a covered deck and alfresco dining table, firepit area, and a private pool with an attached sitting spa—perfect for entertaining! The gourmet kitchen inside is every chef's dream, with high-end appliances, stunning marble countertops, and an extra-large kitchen island with a farmhouse sink. A quaint dining area offers a mix of chair and bench seating for 8, while the breakfast bar seats 9. There is 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed down the hallway. Guests can relax and unwind in the spacious second-floor bedrooms after a long day at the beach. There is 1 primary bedroom with a king bed and access to a private balcony, 2 guest bedrooms with a king and queen bed, and 1 bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds—great for kids and young adults. Above the garage is a charming Carriage House that offers guests a cozy yet private space to decompress at the end of the day. Boasting a quaint kitchenette, comfortable living area, and stacked washer and dryer, guests can enjoy all the conveniences of the big house. There's also 1 guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. Sunshine Smiles is the perfect home base for large groups or families. With WaterColor's courtesy trolley and on-site parking for 5 vehicles it's easy to explore the local area. Book Sunshine Smiles today!
